observations.seen: Flat planes and black void in the hangar, a box-slab ceiling over a flat blue wall in the arena. No architecture, props, or set dressing.
The base mech mesh is decent (~6), but it is buried in untextured cube clusters (~1.5) that read as placeholder.
Floor, walls, and boxes are flat colors with no albedo variation, wear, decals, or normal detail. Only the mech carries texture detail.
Mech metal has some spec response. Everything else is uniform dielectric with a single roughness value.
Metals have nothing meaningful to reflect, and the floor highlight reads as a generic Blinn hotspot rather than grounded PBR.
One big spot wash plus emissives. Fighters get no key/rim separation, and lighting is flat with no motivation.
Blob discs only. No visible mech cast shadows or contact shadows, so the fighters float.
Uniform blue ambient with no AO. Box clusters and creases have no occlusion.
No visible env-map reflections on mech metal and no floor reflections, despite a glossy-floor arena aesthetic that needs them.
Emissives roll off acceptably (ACES/AgX-like). The hangar floor gradient and mobile floor look washed.
sRGB output looks correct. The palette is coherent but monotone cyan-on-navy.
Edges look acceptably smooth at capture. Thin emissive lines show some shimmer risk (inferred).
Bloom only. No SSAO, SSR, DOF, vignette, grading, or chromatic/film treatment.
Glowing rings and floating diamonds only. The action shot has zero combat VFX.
None visible: no sparks, dust, embers, or thruster exhaust.
Stiff identical idle poses with negligible pose delta between "mid" and "action".
The mech is small in frame, cluttered by boxes, and has no rim light. The hangar showcase undersells the hero asset.
Static, high, distant, symmetric. No fighting-game dynamism (low angle, push-in, shake).
Hangar is about 60% dead space. Arena centers on empty floor rings instead of the fighters.
No reference props, haze, or falloff, so mechs could be 2 m or 20 m. The background wall is flat.
No fog, volumetrics, dust motes, or light shafts.
Blue vs. pink team rings and clear bars help. Mechs blend into the dark backdrop.
Clean bars, but the hangar panel is a debug/provenance dump, and the HUD has no hierarchy or game feel.
Monospace dev type throughout, small and low-contrast in the hangar. Functional, not designed.
No hit feedback, transitions, or motion cues. The action frame equals the idle frame.
Both fighters cropped off-screen, HUD eats 28%, keyboard hints on touch, clipped buttons.
One decent mech mesh dropped into a primitive scene with placeholder parts and no combat feedback.
